Feedback

Tell us what went wrong, what you would like to see, or anything else. No account needed, and we read every message.

The message was empty or longer than 8000 characters, so it was not sent. Sorry, the text was not kept: please write it again.

That email address does not look right, so the message was not sent. Please write it again, and leave the email empty if you do not need a reply.

Please choose what the message is about and send it again.

Our server could not save the message. Please try again later, or use GitHub Issues below.

What is it about?

What did you do, what did you expect and what happened instead? Which program and version, if you know. Any of our ten languages is fine.

Only if you want an answer. We keep it apart from your message, never publish it and delete it together with the message.

Please do not include passwords or other people's personal details. The message is kept on our server in the EU for 90 days; your IP address is not stored. More in Privacy.

Other ways

If you prefer to write in public, use GitHub Issues. Report vulnerabilities privately: see security.txt.
